no-goal-help: Create one in your Twitch Creator Dashboard, under Goals.
stale-unreachable-tip: Twitch is not answering, or your internet connection is down. Retrying every minute.
stale-quota-tip: Twitch is limiting requests for now. Retrying in a few minutes.
nothing-shown-help: Choose what to show in the widget options.
stale-refused-tip: Twitch refuses to give this data. Reconnect Twitch in Connected services.
empty-refused: Refused by Twitch. Reconnect Twitch in Connected services.
stale-server-tip: Twitch has a problem for now. Retrying in a few minutes.
empty-server: Twitch unreachable. Retrying in a few minutes.
empty-quota: Twitch is limiting requests. Retrying in a few minutes.
